purpose: Human review packet for encounter mechanic strategy research
review_rules: Numeric ESO Logs ability ids are observational aliases, not canonical mechanic identity.
A repeated log signature is a review candidate, not a mechanic or strategy claim.
Observed player behavior from one group is not universal encounter strategy.
Canonical mechanic binding requires explicit human review with rationale.
Runtime timing remains fight-local evidence unless repeated evidence is reviewed for promotion.

Existing high-confidence Combat Alerts evidence for Reef Guardian explicitly identifies ability 166019 as Crush via TIMER_ALERTS_LEGACY.
Existing high-confidence Combat Alerts evidence for Reef Guardian explicitly identifies ability 166020 as Claw via TIMER_ALERTS_LEGACY.
Existing high-confidence Combat Alerts evidence for Reef Guardian explicitly identifies ability 163701 as the Replication combat event.
